# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Runtime and platform refinements**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156 improves runtime efficiency while updating Android rendering and Apple platform support. The release reduces allocations in image and text processing, fixes front-buffered stream retention, and bundles required WebGPU and HarfBuzz native code more reliably.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture rendering follows the display refresh** — Synchronizes Android texture rendering with the display refresh to provide smoother, more consistent rendering. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Image and text processing allocate less** — Managed image pixel copies and HarfBuzz feature-string processing avoid unnecessary allocations, reducing overhead in repeated image and text operations. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **Front-buffered streams no longer retain data** — Corrects front-buffered stream retention so buffered data can be released when it is no longer needed. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Platform

- **Linux bundles its required HarfBuzz functions** — Binds the bundled HarfBuzz functions locally on Linux, improving the reliability of the native dependency setup. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **WebGPU support is included in the native library** — Packages emdawnwebgpu's webgpu.cpp in libSkiaSharp.a so native consumers receive the WebGPU implementation with the library. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Apple deployment minimums raised** — Updates Apple platform deployment minimums to align the supported target range with current platform requirements. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
